exercises.audio_text: Pour contestable qu'en soit le fondement, cette décision n'en demeure pas moins juridiquement applicable.
exercises.explanation: The end heard is juridiquement applicable. N'en demeure pas moins expresses ‘nevertheless remains’; it does not negate applicability.
exercises.carrier_meaning: However questionable its basis may be, this decision nevertheless remains legally applicable.

exercises.explanation: À condition de introduces a condition. Avant vendredi means before Friday, not on Friday.

choices.text: The explanation did not make him change his mind.

exercises.audio_text: J'ai eu beau lui expliquer la situation, il n'a pas changé d'avis.
exercises.explanation: Avoir beau faire quelque chose means doing it without achieving the hoped-for result. The explanation was unsuccessful.

exercises.answer: She would have accepted only with a guarantee of genuine independence.
accepted: She would have accepted only with a guarantee of genuine independence.

choices.text: She would have accepted only with a guarantee of genuine independence.

exercises.audio_text: Elle n'aurait accepté le poste que si on lui avait garanti une réelle autonomie.
exercises.explanation: Ne… que means ‘only’. The guarantee is a necessary condition for the hypothetical acceptance; the sentence does not say she accepted.
exercises.carrier_meaning: She would have accepted only with a guarantee of genuine independence.

exercises.explanation: Loin de rejects the first interpretation. The reservations aim to clarify the limits; they do not question the project itself.

exercises.audio_text: Il n'est pas jusqu'aux partisans de la réforme qui n'en reconnaissent désormais les effets pervers.
exercises.explanation: Il n'est pas jusqu'à… qui ne… is an emphatic construction meaning ‘even…’. The multiple negative forms do not mean that supporters deny the effects.
